repos.description: :books: 技术面试必备基础知识、Leetcode、计算机操作系统、计算机网络、系统设计
repos.summary_zh: CS-Notes 是面向技术面试的综合性学习资源，涵盖算法、操作系统、计算机网络、数据库、Java 核心技术及系统设计等计算机基础核心领域。内容结构清晰，包含剑指 Offer 和 Leetcode 题解，适合系统复习与刷题备考。
repos.summary_en: CS-Notes is a comprehensive study resource for technical interviews, covering core computer science topics including algorithms, operating systems, computer networks, databases, Java fundamentals, and system design. It features structured content with solutions to 'Jianzhi Offer' and Leetcode problems, ideal for systematic review and coding practice.

repos.description: Bring projects, wikis, and teams together with AI. AppFlowy is the AI collaborative workspace where you achieve more without losing control of your data. The leading open source Notion alternative.
repos.summary_zh: AppFlowy 是一款开源的 AI 协作文档工具，作为 Notion 的替代方案，支持项目、维基与团队协作。基于 Flutter 和 Rust 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端应用，具备数据库、看板、文档及 AI 助手功能，强调数据自主控制与隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: AppFlowy is an open-source AI-powered collaborative workspace and Notion alternative, enabling projects, wikis, and team collaboration. Built with Flutter and Rust, it offers cross-platform desktop and mobile apps with databases, kanban boards, docs, and AI assistance, prioritizing data ownership and privacy.

repos.description: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app that brings your everyday thoughts together in a personal timeline. Your data stays yours, and you choose what to keep private or share.
repos.summary_zh: Memos 是一款开源、自托管的快速笔记工具，专为即时记录设计。原生支持 Markdown，轻量高效，完全由用户掌控数据。提供简洁的时间线界面，无需分类导航，单命令部署，支持 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL，具备完整的 REST/gRPC API，适合个人知识管理和团队协作。
repos.summary_en: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking tool designed for instant capture. Native Markdown support, lightweight (~20MB Docker image), and full data ownership with zero telemetry. Features timeline-first UI, single binary deployment, and extensible via REST/gRPC APIs for personal knowledge management and team use.

repos.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Build your personal knowledge base with Trilium Notes
repos.summary_zh: Trilium Notes 是一款免费开源的跨平台笔记应用，支持构建大型个人知识库。其核心功能包括无限层级树状结构、富文本与 Markdown 编辑器、代码高亮、全文搜索、版本控制及多位置克隆笔记，适用于知识管理与结构化信息存储。
repos.summary_en: Trilium Notes is a free, open-source, cross-platform note-taking app focused on building large personal knowledge bases. It features hierarchical notes with cloning support, rich WYSIWYG editing (including math and code syntax highlighting), full-text search, versioning, and seamless navigation.

repos.description: Your AI second brain. Self-hostable. Get answers from the web or your docs. Build custom agents, schedule automations, do deep research. Turn any online or local LLM into your personal, autonomous AI (gpt, claude, gemini, llama, qwen, mistral). Get started - free.
repos.summary_zh: Khoj 是一款自托管的个人 AI 应用，可作为你的 AI 第二大脑。它支持与本地或在线 LLM（如 Llama3、GPT、Claude、Gemini 等）对话，从互联网或文档中获取答案，并构建自定义智能体、自动化任务及深度研究。具备语义搜索、多格式文档解析、跨平台访问等功能，完全开源且隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Khoj is a self-hostable personal AI app acting as your AI second brain. It enables interaction with any local or online LLM (e.g., Llama3, GPT, Claude), retrieves answers from the web or your documents, builds custom agents, automates research, and supports semantic search across PDFs, Markdown, Notion, Word files, and more. Fully open-source and privacy-focused.

repos.description: A Claude Code plugin that automatically captures everything Claude does during your coding sessions, compresses it with AI (using Claude's agent-sdk), and injects relevant context back into future sessions.
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Mem 是专为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，通过 AI 自动捕获、压缩编码开发会话中的关键信息，并在后续会话中智能注入相关上下文，显著提升 AI 编程助手的工作记忆效率与连续性。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system for Claude Code that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant context from coding sessions using AI, enhancing Claude's working memory and session continuity.

repos.description: This repository is outdated and new Boost Note app is available! We've launched a new Boost Note app which supports real-time collaborative writing. https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote-App
repos.summary_zh: BoostNote-Legacy 是一款面向程序员的开源笔记应用，支持多平台（Mac、Windows、Linux）。该仓库已标记为过时，推荐使用支持实时协作的新版 BoostNote 应用，其基于 Electron、React + Redux 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端支持。
repos.summary_en: BoostNote-Legacy is an open-source note-taking app designed for programmers, supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. This repository is deprecated; users are advised to migrate to the new BoostNote app, which features real-time collaborative writing and is built with Electron, React + Redux.

repos.description: Notion-style WYSIWYG editor with AI-powered autocompletion.
repos.summary_zh: Novel 是一个开源的类 Notion WYSIWYG 编辑器，支持 AI 驱动的自动补全功能。基于 Next.js 和 Tiptap 构建，集成 OpenAI API 实现智能文本补全，提供类似 Notion 的流畅编辑体验，支持跨平台部署与扩展。
repos.summary_en: Novel is an open-source Notion-style WYSIWYG editor featuring AI-powered autocompletion. Built with Next.js and Tiptap, it integrates OpenAI APIs for intelligent text suggestions, offering a seamless editing experience akin to Notion, with cross-platform deployment and extensibility.

repos.description: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code, Codex and other agents as an AI collaborator in your vault.
repos.summary_zh: Claudian 是一款 Obsidian 插件，将 Claude Code 嵌入为 AI 协作者，赋予其完整的代理能力：读写文件、搜索、执行 Bash 命令及多步骤工作流。支持上下文感知、Vision 图像分析、内联编辑、指令模式、Slash 命令、技能扩展、自定义 Agent、Claude Code 插件集成、MCP 协议连接外部工具，并提供高级模型控制与安全权限管理，显著提升知识管理与自动化效率。
repos.summary_en: Claudian is an Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code as an AI collaborator within your vault, providing full agentic capabilities: file read/write, search, bash commands, and multi-step workflows. It supports context-awareness, Vision image analysis, inline editing, instruction mode, slash commands, skills, custom agents, Claude Code plugins, MCP integration for external tools, advanced model control, and security permissions, enhancing knowledge management and automation.

repos.description: A simple, Git-powered wiki with a local frontend and support for many kinds of markup and content.
repos.summary_zh: Gollum 是一个基于 Git 的轻量级 Wiki 系统，支持多种标记语言（如 Markdown、AsciiDoc 等），提供本地前端界面和版本控制功能。它允许用户通过 Git 仓库管理 Wiki 页面，支持实时编辑、历史回溯、数学公式、图表（Mermaid/PlantUML）、BibTeX 引用等高级功能，兼容 GitHub/GitLab Wiki，适合团队协作与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Gollum is a Git-powered wiki system that enables version-controlled, human-editable text files organized in a Git repository. It supports multiple markup languages, real-time editing, page history, diagrams (Mermaid/PlantUML), math rendering, citations, and integrates seamlessly with GitHub/GitLab wikis for collaborative documentation.

repos.description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
repos.summary_zh: NoteGen是一款跨平台Markdown AI笔记软件，专注于通过AI将碎片化信息转化为结构化知识。核心功能包括智能语音转写、RAG知识库构建、MCP工具集成及自动化智能体处理，支持全平台同步且完全免费无广告，适用于高效记录与深度写作场景。
repos.summary_en: NoteGen is a cross-platform Markdown note-taking app that leverages AI to transform fragmented knowledge into structured notes. Key features include voice-to-text transcription, RAG-powered knowledge management, MCP tool integration, and automated AI agents. It offers free sync across all platforms with no ads, ideal for efficient recording and deep writing workflows.

repos.description: Memory for 24/7 proactive agents like openclaw (moltbot, clawdbot).
repos.summary_zh: memU 是一个专为 24/7 主动式 AI 代理设计的内存框架，将内存建模为文件系统，支持层级分类、跨引用和持久化存储。它通过结构化记忆减少 LLM 令牌成本，实现持续理解用户意图并主动执行任务，适用于 openclaw、moltbot 等长期运行代理。
repos.summary_en: memU is a memory framework for 24/7 proactive AI agents, modeling memory as a file system with hierarchical categories, cross-references, and persistent storage. It reduces LLM token costs by caching insights and enables continuous understanding of user intent, making always-on agents practical for production systems like openclaw and moltbot.

repos.description: SimpleMindMap（思绪思维导图）：一个强大的思维导图。A powerful mind map.
repos.summary_zh: 思绪思维导图是一个功能强大的Web思维导图库及客户端软件，提供跨平台支持（Windows/Mac/Linux）和插件生态。核心亮点包括：开源JavaScript库不依赖框架、支持多格式导入导出（XMind/Markdown等）、AI生成主题、手绘风格、节点富媒体编辑、历史版本管理等，兼顾在线使用与本地隐私存储。
repos.summary_en: SimpleMindMap is a powerful mind mapping tool featuring an open-source JavaScript library (framework-agnostic) and a full-featured desktop client. Key highlights include: multi-format import/export (XMind, Markdown), AI-generated themes, hand-drawn styles, rich node editing, version history, and privacy-focused offline operation across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

repos.description: Not Just A Notepad! (golang + mongodb) http://leanote.org
repos.summary_zh: Leanote 是一款功能强大的开源笔记应用，采用 Go 语言和 MongoDB 构建，提供富文本和 Markdown 编辑器，支持 Vim/Emacs 编辑模式、知识管理、协作分享及博客发布。它弥补了 Evernote 在代码高亮、实时渲染、跨平台支持等方面的不足，适合个人与团队知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Leanote is a powerful open-source note-taking app built with Go and MongoDB, featuring rich-text and Markdown editors, Vim/Emacs modes, knowledge management, collaboration, and blogging. It addresses Evernote's limitations in code syntax highlighting, real-time rendering, and cross-platform support, ideal for personal and team knowledge management.

repos.description: Lightweight real-time memory management application to monitor and clean system memory on your computer.
repos.summary_zh: Mem Reduct 是一款轻量级实时内存管理工具，通过调用 Windows 原生 API 清理系统缓存（工作集、备用页列表等），显著释放闲置内存，兼容 Win7+ 64位/ARM64 系统，需管理员权限运行，支持便携模式与 GPG 签名验证。
repos.summary_en: Mem Reduct is a lightweight real-time memory management tool that monitors and cleans system memory by leveraging undocumented Native APIs to clear cache (working set, standby pages). It supports Windows 7+ 64-bit/ARM64, requires admin rights, offers portable mode, and includes GPG-signed binaries for security.

repos.description: An open-source, self-hosted personal AI note tool prioritizing privacy, built using TypeScript .
repos.summary_zh: Blinko 是一款开源的个人 AI 笔记工具，采用 TypeScript 和 Tauri 构建，支持自托管以保障数据隐私。其核心亮点包括基于 RAG 技术的自然语言检索、轻量级跨平台部署（支持 macOS/Windows/Android/Linux）以及 Markdown 编辑功能，让用户能快速捕捉并管理创意想法。
repos.summary_en: Blinko is an open-source, self-hosted personal AI note-taking tool built with TypeScript and Tauri. It emphasizes privacy through local data storage and offers AI-powered RAG-based retrieval, lightweight cross-platform support (macOS/Windows/Android/Linux), and Markdown editing for instant idea capture and organization.

repos.description: Private & local AI personal knowledge management app for high entropy people.
repos.summary_zh: Reor 是一款本地运行的 AI 个人知识管理应用，专为高信息密度人群设计。它基于 Ollama、Transformers.js 和 LanceDB 构建，支持自动关联笔记、语义搜索与 LLM 驱动的问答。所有数据本地存储，提供类 Obsidian 的 Markdown 编辑器，通过向量数据库实现智能内容检索与思维增强。
repos.summary_en: Reor is a private, local AI-powered personal knowledge management app for high-entropy individuals. Built on Ollama, Transformers.js, and LanceDB, it enables automatic note linking, semantic search, and LLM-based Q&A via RAG. All data stays local with an Obsidian-like markdown editor, offering intelligent context retrieval to augment thought.

repos.description: Run agents in Obsidian - OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code etc.
repos.summary_zh: Copilot for Obsidian 是一款专为知识库打造的 AI 助手插件，支持本地与云端大模型接入、智能笔记搜索、多媒体内容理解及自主代理功能。其核心优势在于数据完全由用户掌控，无需依赖第三方服务器，同时提供项目模式、写作辅助和自动化工具调用等高级功能，构建个人专属的 AI 第二大脑。
repos.summary_en: Copilot for Obsidian is an AI assistant plugin designed for knowledge management, integrating local/cloud LLMs, intelligent vault search, multimedia understanding, and autonomous agent capabilities. It emphasizes user data ownership with no provider lock-in, offering advanced features like project mode, writing assistance, and tool automation within Obsidian's customizable workspace.

repos.description: AI 视频笔记生成工具 让 AI 为你的视频做笔记
repos.summary_zh: BiliNote 是一款开源 AI 视频笔记生成工具，支持哔哩哔哩、YouTube、抖音等平台视频链接自动提取内容，结合 GPT 或通义千问等模型生成结构化 Markdown 笔记，支持插入截图、跳转链接及多版本记录，提供本地部署与在线体验。
repos.summary_en: BiliNote is an open-source AI video note generator that automatically extracts content from Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin, and other platforms to create structured Markdown notes using GPT, DeepSeek, or Qwen models. It supports screenshots, jump links, multiple versions, and local deployment with optional CUDA acceleration.

repos.description: Visual Skills Pack for Obsidian: generate Canvas, Excalidraw, and Mermaid diagrams from text with Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: Obsidian视觉技能包通过Claude Code将文本转换为Canvas、Excalidraw和Mermaid图表，支持流程图、思维导图等多种类型，提供手绘风格与动画输出，适用于知识管理与可视化呈现。
repos.summary_en: Visual Skills Pack for Obsidian generates Canvas, Excalidraw, and Mermaid diagrams from text using Claude Code. It supports flowcharts, mind maps, and hierarchical structures with hand-drawn aesthetics, animation modes, and full Chinese text compatibility for knowledge visualization.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目曾用于将微信读书的划线和笔记自动同步至Notion，通过GitHub Action定时执行实现数据迁移。现已因接口限制失效，官方推荐使用Chrome插件替代。项目提供微信群、QQ群支持及捐赠渠道，作者持续维护多个类似自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: This project previously automated syncing WeChat Read highlights and notes to Notion via GitHub Actions. It is now deprecated due to API limitations, with a Chrome extension recommended as the current solution. The author maintains related automation tools and offers community support through WeChat/QQ groups.

repos.description: ✨ The open-source multi-agent platform. Every agent gets its own computer, desktop, network, and long-term memory.  You can bring your own key, or host your coding agent like Claude Code, Codex and so on.

repos.description: 基于 Karpathy llm-wiki 方法论的个人知识库构建 Skill，支持多平台！
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Karpathy llm-wiki 方法论构建的多平台个人知识库自动化系统，支持 PDF、网页、微信公众号、YouTube 等素材的智能提取与结构化整理。通过统一技能接口集成到 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw 等 AI 智能体，实现零配置初始化、双向链接 Wiki 生成、知识健康检查等功能，输出 Obsidian 兼容的 Markdown 格式知识库。
repos.summary_en: A multi-platform personal knowledge base automation system based on Karpathy's llm-wiki methodology. Integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw to automatically extract and structure content from PDFs, web articles, WeChat, YouTube, and more into a bidirectional linked wiki. Features zero-config setup, intelligent routing, batch processing, and outputs Obsidian-compatible markdown.

repos.description: ✨ The open-source multi-agent platform. Every agent gets its own computer, desktop, network, and long-term memory.  You can bring your own key, or host your coding agent like Claude Code, Codex and so on.
repos.summary_zh: Memoh 是一个自托管的容器化 AI 智能体平台，支持创建多个具备长期记忆能力的独立机器人。通过 Docker 实现容器级隔离，可连接 Telegram、Discord、Feishu（Lark）、Matrix 等通信渠道，提供图形化配置界面和 MCP 工具调用能力，适用于家庭或团队的多成员协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Memoh is a self-hosted, containerized AI agent platform enabling multiple bots with persistent long-term memory. Each bot runs in isolated containers and integrates with platforms like Telegram, Discord, Feishu (Lark), and Matrix via a web UI, supporting role-based access and cross-platform identity recognition for team or family use.

repos.description: Markdown 批量导出工具、开放式跨平台博客解决方案，随意组合写作平台(语雀/Notion/FlowUs/飞书/我来Wolai)和博客平台(Hexo/Vitepress/Halo/Confluence/WordPress等)
repos.summary_zh: Elog 是一个开放式跨平台博客解决方案，支持将语雀、Notion、飞书等写作平台与 Hexo、VitePress、WordPress 等博客平台自由组合。它通过 Markdown 批量导出和图床上传功能，打通内容创作与发布的壁垒，提供灵活的文档处理适配器与插件生态，满足开发者与内容创作者的多场景需求。
repos.summary_en: Elog is an open-source cross-platform blogging solution that enables flexible integration between writing platforms (e.g., Notion, Yuque, Feishu) and blog engines (e.g., Hexo, VitePress, WordPress). It supports bulk Markdown export, image hosting via multiple cloud providers, customizable adapters, and extensible plugins to streamline content publishing workflows.

repos.description: 📝 一个一键导出 / 备份「有道云笔记」所有笔记的 Python 脚本。 A Python script to export/backup all the notes of the "Youdao Note".
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本实现有道云笔记一键导出与备份，支持将笔记按原格式下载至本地并自动转换为 Markdown 格式。内置图床图片本地化或上传 SM.MS 功能，完全本地运行保障数据安全，提供可视化配置文件和视频教程，适合非技术人员使用。
repos.summary_en: This script enables one-click export and backup of all notes from Youdao Note, downloading files locally in original format and converting them to Markdown. It supports local image hosting or uploading to SM.MS, runs entirely offline for security, and includes user-friendly config files and video guides for non-technical users.

repos.description: 一键将视频转换为优质小红书笔记，自动优化内容和配图
repos.summary_zh: 视频笔记生成器一键将视频内容转换为优质小红书笔记，支持自动语音转文字、AI内容优化、标题创作、配图获取及标签生成。V2.0版本采用FastAPI提供现代化Web界面，支持批量处理、长视频解析、智能错误重试与历史记录管理，显著提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Video Note Generator automatically converts videos into high-quality Xiaohongshu notes with speech-to-text, AI content optimization, title generation, image fetching, and hashtag creation. V2.0 features a modern FastAPI web interface, batch processing, 30-minute video support, smart retry mechanisms, and history tracking for efficient content production.

repos.description: Obsidian Plugin to execute code in a note.
repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Execute Code 插件支持在笔记中直接运行代码块，提供一键执行、交互式输入和结果展示功能。目前已支持 Python、R、Octave 等 30+ 种编程语言，并支持魔法命令、全局代码注入及持久化输出（实验性）。适用于数据科学、教学演示和自动化脚本场景。
repos.summary_en: The Obsidian Execute Code plugin enables direct execution of code blocks within notes, featuring one-click run buttons, interactive input prompts, and real-time output display. It supports over 30 languages including Python, R, and Octave, with magic commands, global code injections, and experimental persistent output for PDF export. Ideal for data science, teaching, and scripting workflows.

repos.description: Agent-native AI assistant — chat, write, whiteboard, learning, all in one.
repos.summary_zh: YOLO 是一款专为 Obsidian 设计的智能 AI 助手插件，支持 Agent 模式、多窗口对话和知识库问答。通过工具调用与自定义技能实现自动化操作，结合 RAG 技术将整个知识库作为上下文，提供多语言、多模型支持的流畅写作与任务处理体验。
repos.summary_en: YOLO is an intelligent, multilingual AI assistant plugin for Obsidian, featuring Agent mode with tool calling and custom skills, multi-window chat, RAG-powered knowledge base Q&A, and seamless integration with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and other mainstream LLMs.

repos.description: ❤️‍🔥 A chrome extension as an alternative to Notion AI that goes beyond Notion AI. | 一个替代 Notion AI 的浏览器插件，不止于 Notion AI
repos.summary_zh: Writely 是一款基于 OpenAI GPT 模型的浏览器插件，旨在替代 Notion AI。它支持在任意网页编辑器中提供智能写作辅助、邮件撰写、文章创作及社交媒体互动等功能，显著提升用户的内容创作效率与质量，实现跨平台的智能文本处理体验。
repos.summary_en: Writely is a browser extension powered by OpenAI's GPT model, designed as an alternative to Notion AI. It enables intelligent writing assistance across any webpage editor, supporting email composition, article drafting, and social media interactions, thereby enhancing content creation efficiency and quality with cross-platform accessibility.

repos.description: Lumina Note - A modern Markdown note-taking app with live preview, bidirectional links, and AI assistant
repos.summary_zh: Lumina Note 是一款本地优先的 AI 笔记应用，支持 Markdown 实时预览、双向链接（WikiLinks）和知识图谱可视化。集成多模态 AI 助手（Chat/Agent/Deep Research/Codex），提供本地语义检索（RAG）功能，确保数据完全掌控于用户手中。
repos.summary_en: Lumina Note is a local-first AI note-taking app featuring live Markdown preview, bidirectional links, and knowledge graph visualization. It integrates multimodal AI assistants (Chat/Agent/Deep Research/Codex) with local RAG retrieval, ensuring full data ownership and privacy.

repos.description: 一个基于AI的学生错题本

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Karpathy llm-wiki 方法论构建的个人 AI 知识库系统，支持从网页、社交媒体、PDF 等多元素材源自动提取并结构化生成 wiki 内容，通过 Quartz 发布为静态网站，并利用 Claude Agent SDK 提供 API 服务，实现端到端的智能知识管理与检索增强生成（RAG）。

repos.description: 🧠 OpenClaw 融合记忆方案 — 三层 cron 自动记忆提取/蒸馏/巩固，零插件、零侵入、永不失忆
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Memory Fusion 是一个基于 OpenClaw 原生能力的融合记忆增强方案，通过三层 cron 机制（每小时/每天/每周）实现自动记忆提取、蒸馏与巩固。采用本地 session JSONL 为事实源，LLM 提炼高信噪比内容，Markdown 落盘确保可审计性。具备增量游标防重放、防套娃污染、Telegram 运维通知等特性，支持零插件侵入部署。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw Memory Fusion is a memory enhancement solution built on OpenClaw's native capabilities, featuring three-tier cron automation (hourly/daily/weekly) for automatic memory extraction, distillation, and consolidation. It uses local session JSONL as the truth source, LLM-based refinement with high-signal input, and Markdown storage for auditability. Key features include incremental byte-offset cursors to prevent duplication, anti-recursion safeguards, and Telegram-based operational notifications, enabling zero-plugin deployment.

repos.description: A battle-tested two-layer memory system for AI agents that need to remember across sessions.
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Memory Architecture 是一套经过实战验证的 AI Agent 长期记忆系统，解决跨会话失忆问题。采用双层文件架构（热缓存 MEMORY.md + 深度存储 memory/），结合确定性查找与语义搜索检索协议，通过 Supersede 机制追踪事实演变，并引入程序职员模式自动沉淀知识。所有数据以 Markdown+JSON 格式存储，Git 友好且透明可控，确保在嵌入服务不可用时仍具备 90% 日常场景的零依赖检索能力。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw Memory Architecture is a battle-tested two-layer memory system for AI agents requiring cross-session recall. It features a hot cache (MEMORY.md) and deep storage (memory/) with deterministic lookup and semantic search protocols, Supersede mechanism for fact evolution tracking, and a 'program clerk' process for automated knowledge proposal with human review. Built on Git-friendly Markdown/JSON, it maintains 90% zero-dependency functionality even when embedding services fail.

It features note-taking with auto-tagging, behavior logging, RAG-enhanced responses, and spaced repetition review based on the Ebbinghaus curve.
